# The moon: a faceted ball 4 m in radius, origin at its centre (the game rolls it about the view
# axis). Front half only. Crater rims on its face, boulders on its rim. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.306 0.286 0.373 --no-slot
material new Dust --base-color 0.506 0.384 0.443 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Moon --subdivisions 3 --radius 4.0
material assign Rock
active Moon
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.35"
delete only-faces
select all
randomize --amount 0.07 --seed 3
mode object
add mesh torus --name Crater0 --major-segments 9 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.61 --minor-radius 0.18 --location -0.658 -3.699 1.314 --rotation 0 70.72 -100.08
